goals.name: ATX Flex Manager + SA Ops Manager Development
goals.assessment: Screening is closed and peer review is in flight across all four branches. Seven of eight applicants qualified (Sullivan Lowe screened out on the six-month Lead bar); no further cut was made at this gate — the cover-letter instruction shipped in the messaging but never made it onto the application link, so a weak application score can't be cleanly read as low effort versus a missed instruction. Scoring model rebuilt to weight only evidence-carrying categories: On-Site Evaluations 30, Peer Review 30, Application 25, EMC Games 15, with résumé/tenure/attempts as reference. Games no longer scales down — 10+ on the 1–13 scale is the top score. Application grade now measures the whole written case wherever the candidate made it, with a missing cover letter recorded as a miss but unweighted. Peer evaluation forms built and sent per branch, each naming the South Austin position explicitly; South Austin and Houston ride Training Days 8/19 and 8/20, North Austin is pulsed to Daniel Behseresht with an 80%-response target, Fort Worth sent direct with Mike in the loop. Rationale posted to the live pulse for Cameron and Anne. Projects added as a distinct stage between peer review and interviews. Seats already closed: Daniel Behseresht N. Austin BM (8/10), Hector Zavala S. Austin Ops (8/11), Calvin Hughes to Remote Flex (8/11). Remaining: peer scores, the project stage, interviews, decision, and the documented 30/60/90 the green bar actually requires.
